rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad you reached out, and thank you — five hours a week of real analytical help is a lot. Here's a concrete first ask, if it sounds like a good fit: a landscape scan of AI evaluation efforts — who's evaluating what, and where the actual gaps are. I'm specifically interested in the degree to which eval/safety-testing attention goes to frontier flagship models (where it's crowded) versus widely-used consumer-facing products like companion apps or assistant features bolted onto ordinary software (where it seems much thinner). A simple spreadsheet of existing evals/benchmarks, who runs them, what they cover, and a short note on where you see the biggest gaps would be hugely useful and is very matched to a data-analyst skill set. No pressure on timeline — whenever you have the hours. Happy to hop on a call first if that's easier than working from a cold brief. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: replied to Priya Raman (the volunteer from the meetup) asking her to do a landscape scan of what's already being evaluated vs. what's neglected — that's private correspondence, no public claims made.
